metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a well-defined, distinct micro skill for executing individual path drawing commands. It has clear objective (execute single path drawing operation), specific workflow (verify path exists → select command → prepare parameters → invoke → verify state), and concrete constraints/cautions. No overlap with peer candidates: D3 Transform Manipulation addresses coordinate transforms (different domain), Path Serializer Instantiation addresses object creation (different stage), and Schedule One-Shot Timer addresses timing (unrelated domain). Support evidence from d3-path API confirms the skill's validity. No conflicts detected.
